name: PartyPass
original_description: PartyPass turns an invitation you created with your AI assistant into a hosted, shareable event page. Generate an invitation in chat as HTML or an image, then host it on PartyPass to get a preview link and a claim link. After claiming, you can publish the invitation and send it to guests on WhatsApp, with QR passes, reminders, and RSVP tracking handled by PartyPass. This integration only hosts the invitation and returns links; it never sends messages or charges on its own.
